description: This file defines a class implementing Azure Content Safety moderation integrated with a proxy system, including methods for configuration, content analysis, and request hooks.

classes.name: _PROXY_AzureContentSafety
classes.description: A class that integrates Azure Content Safety service with a proxy, providing methods for content analysis, configuration, and hooks for pre- and post-call processing.

methods.name: __init__(self, endpoint, api_key, thresholds=None)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Azure Content Safety client and configuration thresholds.

methods.name: _configure_thresholds(self, thresholds=None)
methods.description: Sets default thresholds or applies provided thresholds for content moderation severity levels.

methods.name: _compute_result(self, response)
methods.description: Processes the Azure Content Safety response to determine if content violates policy based on severity thresholds.

methods.name: test_violation(self, content: str, source: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Analyzes a piece of content to check for safety violations, raising HTTPException if content breaches thresholds.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: str, )
methods.description: Pre-call hook that checks input messages for violations before processing requests.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Post-call hook that inspects the response and verifies output content for safety violations.

ctags.signature: ( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: str, )
